scenicChapters.title: Srinagar-Leh Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 4108 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Fotu La → Leh
scenicChapters.narrative: 175 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

srinagar-leh-highway-lamayuru-leh.story: The highest point is about 4,600 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

places-technikum-seematte.story: A 166 km round trip from Rapperswil - roughly 2 h 52 in the saddle. On the way it passes Storen-Wildsberg, Riedmatt, Seematte and back through Riedmatt. The highest point is about 1,200 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
